explanation: The area that God promised to give to the people of Israel, which Joshua and his army conquered.
One of the twelve spies whom Moses sent to explore Canaan. He remained faithful to God and was rewarded with a portion of land in Canaan.
A city in Canaan that Caleb received as an inheritance for his faithfulness to God.
A people who lived in Canaan and were known for being large and strong warriors.
The leader of the people of Israel after Moses' death, and he led them into Canaan.
A gift or property passed from one generation to another, often used in a biblical context to describe the lands God gave to the tribes of Israel.
